result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the metadata line under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has overlapping text, making it illegible. A minor styling inconsistency exists between the favourite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' the delivery-time and delivery-fee texts are drawn on top of each other, producing garbled output ('25–3€0mdielivery • Ramen'). The metadata row is not laid out with proper spacing/flow.
issues.suggestion: Render the meta items in a single flex row with a gap or bullet separators and ensure no absolute positioning/negative margins overlap the elements; allow text to wrap or truncate instead of overlapping.

issues.description: The favourite heart button on the first 'Popular right now' card uses a white/light background with a dark outline, while the second card's heart button uses a dark background, creating inconsistent control styling.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button treatment (same background, border and icon colour) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol…') has a much lighter/washed-out first card image compared to the other tiles, suggesting a missing or low-contrast image asset for 'Green Bowl Poké'.
issues.suggestion: Verify image assets load at consistent dimensions and contrast; add a neutral placeholder background consistent with other cards.
